read_text:
Captain's Log – Day 212

We are close now. The red planet fills the forward window, and none of us can sleep.

The old girl is holding up better than anyone expected – not bad for a ship that first left the hangar in 2073. She's older than half her crew!

The engineers still use her birth year for everything: lockers, panels, even the coffee machine. One day someone will steal our biscuits.

– Cpt. M. Reyes
